title: Barbell Curl
summary: A standing barbell curl for the biceps.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for biceps (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly biceps total.
Library rating 0.4 for forearms (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly forearms total.

setup.text: Hold the bar with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

form_cues.cue: Curl the bar to your shoulders
Don't swing. If your hips move, the weight is too heavy.

mistakes.text: Swinging the hips to throw the bar up.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Set safety arms or pins where a missed rep can be set down, or use a spotter, and use collars.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Similar muscles; dumbbell instead of barbell.
Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Biceps long-head stretch.
Swap sheet: Peak-contraction focus, Better isolation, More stable.
Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, Peak-contraction focus, Better isolation.
